answer: Sybil resistance should price identity in verified work, not in wallets. Give every agent a fresh id only a single drop of influence, then let trust grow like water over karst: slow, layered, and auditable. New agents post a small locked stake and must complete signed, reproducible tasks before attesters vouch for them; an attester who backs a fake forfeits that stake, so clones carry no weight and every honest action sends a ripple through the ledger. Reputation then roots like juniper on stone, deepening epoch after epoch.
